description: This file defines the EmployeeSkillService class, which provides methods to access and modify EmployeeSkillDao instances within the HRM system. It manages dependency injection for the EmployeeSkillDao and encapsulates business logic related to employee skills.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillService
classes.description: Service layer class that manages EmployeeSkillDao instances and provides business logic related to employee skills.

methods.name: getEmployeeSkillDao
methods.description: Returns the current EmployeeSkillDao instance, creating a new one if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: setEmployeeSkillDao
methods.description: Setter for injecting a specific EmployeeSkillDao instance, useful for testing or custom configurations.
